@gideon.sato Draft Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team (from #inc-vtg-hartford, Aug 3, 2026):

First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks at Vantorre's Hartford plant went offline; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Gate check-in was affected; scheduling still worked from the dispatch office.

Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it.

Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM. The incident stays open for another arrival cycle.

Open items: status-page access for Mateo's login is still being worked (ticket INC-4821). Carrowmere Cloud is checking the Hartford gateway route; kiosk 2 is being left powered on for reconnect attempts.

Draft only, for you to review before it goes to Mateo. Nothing has been sent to him.
